note: The first-party MCP clients, pre-registered at the OAuth server with fixed IDs, PKCE and exact redirect URIs (AI-35; p1-mcp-first-party tasks 3.1, 3.2). The ID is the app's name on an organisation's allowlist (mcp.clients). Redirects are exact. Hydra matches a registered portless 127.0.0.1 or [::1] URI on any port (RFC 8252) and does NOT do so for localhost, which Claude Code uses: its URI is registered with the port Claude Code is told to use (claude mcp add --callback-port 3118). Claude Desktop's redirect is Anthropic's hosted callback and is [live-verify].

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.verify: Claude Code 2.1.327 asks for http://localhost:<port>/callback and takes a fixed port with --callback-port; Hydra matches localhost exactly, so the port is part of the registration

clients.name: Claude Desktop
clients.verify: [live-verify] Anthropic's hosted callback for remote connectors; not provable on a local stack
